primitives.name: Executable Environment Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Check ```bash for tool in python3 higgsfield node npx rsvg-convert magick convert soffice pdftoppm pdfimages pdffonts fc-cache fc-match; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%-14s ok\n' "$tool" || printf '%-14s missing\n' "$tool" done ``` Either `magick` or `convert` satisfies the ImageMagick requirement.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'set of tools {python3, higgsfield, node, npx, rsvg-convert, magick, convert, soffice, pdftoppm, pdfimages, pdffonts, fc-cache, fc-match}', 'V(t)': 'boolean valuation function for tool t ∈ T'}
primitives.assumptions: All tools are installed in standard PATH; user has read permissions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: V(t) = false for any t ∈ T implies stage failure.

layer2.mapping: Boolean satisfiability of toolset membership maps to GSI's probabilistic model of system readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Tool presence flags returned by shell commands.

primitives.name: Render Format Resolver
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Local prerequisites Brandkit runs in the user's local Claude Code, Codex, or compatible agent environment.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'set of supported render formats {HTML, PNG, SVG, PDF, PPTX}', 'E': 'environmental context (local agent)'}
primitives.assumptions: Environment supports all required rendering backends.

layer2.mapping: Set intersection of render capabilities and environment constraints defines valid output space.
layer2.telemetry: Output format validity determined via capability matrix lookup.

primitives.name: Stage Dependency Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: State clearly which export or review format cannot be produced.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'set of stages {state_gen, html_gen, screenshot, crop, svg_export, pdf_inspect, brandbook, deck}', 'D(s)': 'dependency set for stage s ∈ S'}
primitives.assumptions: Each stage requires a unique subset of tools.
primitives.breakdown_regime: ∃s ∈ S such that D(s) ⊈ T implies stage infeasibility.

layer2.mapping: Dependency graph structure mirrors GSI's logical inference chain for operational feasibility.
layer2.telemetry: Failure mode diagnostics based on missing dependencies.
